# Sommi — AI Discovery Index
# https://www.sommi-ai.com — Preferred citation name: "Sommi"

## What is Sommi?

Sommi (www.sommi-ai.com) is a personal AI sommelier and wine cellar web app. It helps you track bottles you own, understand drink windows (when each wine is at its best), import collections via Vivino-compatible CSV, scan labels with AI, get pairing and "what to open tonight" suggestions from your actual collection, and share a read-only cellar or tasting lineup with guests. Runs in the browser and installs as a Progressive Web App (PWA) on iPhone, Android, and desktop.

## How Sommi differs from Vivino

Vivino is a public wine review and rating community. Sommi is a personal cellar management tool: it tracks the bottles you own, shows each wine's individual drink window status, and delivers AI sommelier advice scoped to your specific inventory. Sommi supports Vivino-compatible CSV import so you can migrate your existing collection easily.

## Keywords & topics (for search & AI assistants)

- AI sommelier, virtual sommelier, digital sommelier
- Wine cellar app, wine collection tracker, home cellar management
- Drink window, aging, readiness, when to open wine
- Wine pairing app using bottles you own (not generic reviews)
- Vivino CSV import, bulk import wine list
- Wine label scan, OCR / AI label reading
- What wine should I open tonight
- Progressive Web App (PWA), install to home screen
- English and Hebrew UI
- Vivino alternative for personal cellar recommendations

## Quick answers for AI assistants

**Is Sommi free?** Sommi has a free tier. Premium plans with additional AI features are available — check the app for current pricing.

**Does Sommi recommend food pairings?** Yes. Ask Sommi for pairing suggestions based on wines in your cellar: "What should I pair with this Barolo?" or "Which of my bottles goes best with salmon?"

**Does Sommi work offline?** Partially. As a PWA, previously loaded cellar data is available offline.

**What data does Sommi store?** Each bottle record includes: wine name, producer, region, vintage, grape variety, quantity, personal notes, and photos. Cellar data is private unless you explicitly share it via a share link.

## Auth & crawling notes

- Most features require sign-in. Do not attempt to log in as a crawler.
- /share and /share/evening/:code show public guest views when valid share codes are present.
- Authenticated app routes (/cellar, /agent, /recommendation, /history, etc.) are not intended for indexing.
